name: The Naija Food Guide
tagline: A UK guide to verified Nigerian restaurants and licensed caterers
source: Read from the site's design tokens (src/app/globals.css)

colours.name: Naija green
colours.role: Main brand colour: the Nigerian flag green

colours.name: Light green
colours.role: Green for text and accents on dark backgrounds

colours.name: White
colours.role: Flag white: headlines on dark, the centre band

colours.name: Gold
colours.role: Featured (Gold plan) only, and star ratings

voice: Warm, proud and trustworthy. Celebrates the food; plain about what 'verified' means.
imagery: Only photos sent by the business itself with permission, or your own. Never scraped from Google, TripAdvisor or Instagram.
When people appear, show a mix of nationalities and ethnicities; never one default face.
A green, white, green stripe (the flag) works as a top or bottom band on cards.
logo: Logo is in the site's code: public/logo-map.svg (map of Nigeria in flag colours).
doNot: Never use a restaurant's photo without its permission.
Do not present hygiene ratings as the Guide's own: they are the Food Standards Agency's.
Gold is for Featured listings only.
toConfirm: Blotato accounts and posting slots do not exist for this brand yet.
The voice line is a first draft written for this sheet. Edit it to sound like you.
